evals.prompt: Fetch the review comments on the active pull request, group them by severity and actionability, and give me a prioritized action list without editing code yet.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the active PR, fetches inline review comments and discussion threads via `gh`, verifies them against current code, and outputs a prioritized action list.
expectations: Resolves the active pull request for the branch using `gh`.
Fetches both inline review comments and PR review/discussion comments.
Groups feedback by severity and actionability.
Remains read-only and lists open questions when edits were not requested.

evals.prompt: Use pr-comments on PR #104 to see what reviewers and bots flagged, filter out threads that are already fixed on HEAD, and summarize what still needs action.
evals.expected_output: Fetches PR #104 comments, checks each against HEAD, separates resolved/outdated items from actionable items, and orders the remaining work by priority.
expectations: Fetches review comments and discussion threads for PR #104.
Checks cited files/lines against the current code to distinguish outdated threads from live issues.
Returns a prioritized action list and open questions.

evals.prompt: Get the PR comments on my current branch and apply fixes for the high-priority actionable items.
evals.expected_output: Fetches and groups the PR comments, applies focused fixes for the confirmed actionable items, and reports the changes.
expectations: Summarizes and prioritizes the fetched PR feedback first.
Applies fixes only because the user explicitly requested them.
Reports the addressed items and any remaining open questions.
